::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 10 minutes\
**Cook time:** 10 minutes

[Main]{.badge .badge-main}
:::

*You can use any type of white fish for this recipe, but catfish makes it more relatable.*

## Ingredients

### Fish

- 1 catfish filet
- 1 tbsp butter
- 1 tbsp olive oil
- garlic salt (to taste)
- black pepper (to taste)
- cumin (to taste)
- cayenne (to taste)
- paprika (to taste)

### Garnish

- ¼ onion (diced)
- 1 small tomato (diced)
- fresh cilantro (chopped)

## Instructions

1. Season the catfish on both sides.
2. Sear the catfish in olive oil over medium high heat, 4 minutes on each side.
3. Mix in the butter and baste for 1 minute.
4. Chop the catfish in the pan.
5. Serve on a corn tortilla and garnish with onion, tomato, and cilantro.
